title: Morgan Stanley warns AI chip rally may be running out of steam

title: Circle shares surge 13% on getting regulatory approval to set up US trust bank
description: Circle secured final regulatory approval from the OCC for its national trust bank. This allows the stablecoin issuer to manage its own reserves and client crypto assets. The charter places Circle's bank under direct federal supervision by the OCC. Digital asset firms are increasingly seeking traditional financial services and banking licenses. Circle is the issuer of USDC, a stablecoin pegged to the U.S. dollar.

title: Global Markets: Chinese fast fashion retailer Shein finally wins approval for Hong Kong IPO

Although the company has faced strict regulatory examination and backlash in the US and UK markets, it seeks to rebound. Currently, investors project its valuation could be between forty to fifty billion dollars. This IPO represents a vital turning point for Hong Kong's vibrant financial ecosystem.

title: PFC raises USD 300 mn via bonds carrying floating interest rates
description: Power Finance Corporation, a state-run entity, has triumphantly secured USD 300 million via bonds that feature floating interest rates. Following the guidelines set by the RBI, these Notes are set to mature in July 2029 and will provide payments in US Dollars. They are scheduled for listing on NSE IFSC and India INX, marking a significant financial achievement.

title: South Korean billionaire's risky bet pays off, as SK Hynix debuts in New York

This strategic investment has positioned SK Hynix as a key player in the booming artificial intelligence industry. However, concerns about future demand and potential oversupply are now emerging. Chey's leadership style and past controversies also define his unique corporate legacy.

title: Warsh task force members get an A at the outset, but results will need broad buy-in
description: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh has enlisted a team of fifteen renowned external experts to spearhead reform task forces. This diverse group features both foreign central bankers and individuals from the former Obama administration, emphasizing the strength of expertise compared to other independent agencies. Warsh aims to wrap up this review process by year's end, marking a pivotal move towards possible institutional and policy overhauls.

title: Wall Street banks rule on staff betting on prediction markets, sources say
description: In a significant move, major Wall Street banks have revised their employee conduct guidelines. The updated policies impose restrictions on engaging in financial and political prediction markets. Specifically, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley have enacted firm prohibitions, while JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America have also established comparable limitations. These initiatives are designed to eliminate conflicts of interest and maintain compliance with industry standards.

title: SpaceX's near-term AI payoff seen tethered to Earth, not outer space
description: SpaceX's current value stems from building essential AI infrastructure on Earth. The company is generating significant revenue from terrestrial compute contracts with major clients. These deals are expected to far exceed income from other SpaceX businesses this year. Orbital AI remains a longer-term prospect dependent on technological advancements. Analysts believe terrestrial compute will drive SpaceX's growth for the remainder of this decade.
